plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: Manual-only interrogatives for work in progress: /why /where /what /how /who /when. Claims carry checkable provenance instead of a confidence score, and nothing here writes.

plugins.name: dialect
plugins.description: Manual-only controlled-language modes. Constrains the vocabulary, sentence shape, evidence, and order of what Claude writes to a published rule set, for one target or for the rest of the session. Ships /ste (ASD-STE100), /plain (ISO 24495-1 plain language), /ubiquitous (ubiquitous language), /calibrated (ICD 203 analytic standards), /normative (RFC 2119 keywords), /bluf (bottom line up front), /pyramid (Minto), /sbar (clinical handoff), /comments (Conventional Comments), and /diataxis (four documentation modes).

plugins.name: hub
plugins.description: Manual-only hub-and-spoke orchestration. /hub turns the main session into a dispatcher that decomposes a task, writes self-contained cold-start briefs, gates the plan for approval, fans work out to subagents, verifies what comes back, and integrates. Delegation is the default, and a direct edit is a stated exception the hub has to justify and disclose.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Manual-only visualizations: table, list, tree, flowchart, sequence, kanban, and 9 more, rendered by a bundled zero-dependency script that computes alignment and padding so columns and connectors never drift; most skills draw with Unicode box-drawing and symbols, while list and checklist keep plain ASCII markers, since a single decorator glyph proved too subtle to read reliably.
